FROM v_sales

  AND order_date >= DATE '2026-10-01'

       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY customer_city
ORDER BY order_cnt DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH period_rates AS (
  SELECT
    supplier_name,
    CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'p1' ELSE 'p2' END AS period,
    AVG(CASE WHEN on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS on_time_rate
  FROM v_purchasing
  WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL
    AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-10-31'
  GROUP BY supplier_name, period
), diffs AS (
  SELECT
    p1.supplier_name,
    p1.on_time_rate AS rate_p1,
    p2.on_time_rate AS rate_p2,
    (p2.on_time_rate - p1.on_time_rate) AS drop_rate
  FROM period_rates p1
  JOIN period_rates p2 ON p1.supplier_name = p2.supplier_name
  WHERE p1.period = 'p1' AND p2.period = 'p2'
)
SELECT
  supplier_name,
  round(rate_p1::numeric, 4) AS rate_jan_apr,
  round(rate_p2::numeric, 4) AS rate_may_oct,
  round(drop_rate::numeric, 4) AS drop_rate
FROM diffs
ORDER BY drop_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS month,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
    AND order_date < DATE '2026-11-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round(((oct.rev - sep.rev) / NULLIF(sep.rev, 0)) * 100::numeric, 2) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM monthly_rev sep
JOIN monthly_rev oct ON oct.month = DATE '2026-10-01'
WHERE sep.month = DATE '2026-09-01'

SELECT category,
       round((SUM(margin)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(revenue),0)) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cust_rev AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           SUM(revenue) AS rev
    FROM v_sales
    WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY customer_id
), total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(rev) AS total
    FROM cust_rev
), top10_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(rev) AS top_sum
    FROM (
        SELECT rev
        FROM cust_rev
        ORDER BY rev DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ) t
)
SELECT round((top_sum::numeric / total)::numeric * 100, 2) AS top10_rev_pct
FROM top10_rev, total_rev

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', order_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
       round(sum(revenue)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM v_sales
WHERE order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date)
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH rev_q2 AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q2
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
rev_q3 AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q3
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM rev_q2 q2
JOIN rev_q3 q3 USING (customer_id)
WHERE q2.rev_q2 > 0
  AND q3.rev_q3 < q2.rev_q2

SELECT
  category,
  round(sum(on_hand * unit_cost)::numeric, 2) AS inventory_value_cost
FROM v_products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY inventory_value_cost DESC

SELECT product_id,
       sku,
       product_name,
       (on_hand * unit_cost) AS inventory_value
FROM v_products
ORDER BY inventory_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT round(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'paid')::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS paid_pct
FROM v_receivables
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) = 2026

WITH cust_rev AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_segment,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id, customer_segment
)
SELECT
  customer_segment AS segment,
  round(avg(total_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rev_per_customer
FROM cust_rev
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY segment

SELECT
  r.customer_id,
  r.customer_name,
  round(sum(r.balance)::numeric, 2) AS total_overdue_balance,
  count(*) AS overdue_invoice_count
FROM v_receivables r
WHERE r.status = 'overdue'
GROUP BY r.customer_id, r.customer_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_balance DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT round(
        (SELECT coalesce(sum(revenue),0)::numeric FROM v_sales WHERE order_status='completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31') -
        (SELECT coalesce(sum(revenue),0)::numeric FROM v_sales WHERE order_status='completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2026-08-31')
    ,2) AS revenue_diff

WITH q2 AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         product_name,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q2
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
q3 AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         product_name,
         SUM(revenue) AS rev_q3
  FROM v_sales
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT q3.product_id,
         q3.product_name,
         COALESCE(q2.rev_q2, 0) AS rev_q2,
         q3.rev_q3,
         (q3.rev_q3 - COALESCE(q2.rev_q2, 0)) AS rev_change
  FROM q3
  LEFT JOIN q2 ON q3.product_id = q2.product_id
)
SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       round(rev_q2::numeric, 2) AS rev_q2,
       round(rev_q3::numeric, 2) AS rev_q3,
       round(rev_change::numeric, 2) AS rev_change
FROM combined
ORDER BY rev_change DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT round(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN on_time = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS pct_late FROM v_purchasing WHERE received_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    s.product_id,
    s.product_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS units_sold,
    SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(s.margin) AS total_margin,
    round((SUM(s.margin) / NULLIF(SUM(s.revenue),0))::numeric, 4) AS margin_pct
FROM v_sales s
WHERE s.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY s.product_id, s.product_name
HAVING SUM(s.qty) >= 100
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 3
